description_en: You can call UpdateSharedAccountPermission to update the permissions of a shared account
description_zh: 调用UpdateSharedAccountPermission更新共享账号的权限
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier update-shared-account-permission --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id service-0d6e1d846e4c4axxxxxx --user-ali-uid 1563457855 --permission Deployable --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSharedAccountPermission

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter on your client. The client token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The whitelisted account with which the service is shared
parameters.help_zh: 服务共享的白名单账号
parameters.name: user_ali_uid

parameters.help_en:
The permission type. Valid values:

Deployable: The service can be deployed.

Accessible: The service can be accessed.

AccessibleIncludeBeta: All versions of the service, including beta versions, can be accessed.

DeployableIncludeBeta: All versions of the service, including beta versions, can be deployed.

Authorized: The service is authorized. This value is used for distribution scenarios.

Unauthorized: The service is not authorized. This value is used for distribution scenarios
parameters.help_zh:
权限类型。可能的值：
Deployable：可部署。
Accessible：可访问。
AccessibleIncludeBeta：可访问所有版本，包括Beta版本。
DeployableIncludeBeta：可部署所有版本，包括Beta版本。
Authorized：已授权（用于分销场景）
Unauthorized：未授权（用于分销场景）
parameters.name: permission

parameters.help_en:
The type of service sharing. The default value is SharedAccount. Valid values:

SharedAccount: Regular sharing.

Reseller: Distribution sharing
parameters.help_zh:
服务共享类型，默认值为SharedAccount。可选值：

SharedAccount：普通共享类型。

Reseller：分销共享类型
parameters.name: type
